parts.text: @Titan-LiveOps Shard EU-West-03 is showing 14% packet loss and matchmaking timeouts following the 30.10 update. Run an incident diagnosis and provide mitigation.

[P1 INCIDENT REPORT]
- Incident Severity: P1
- Root Cause Summary: EOS Gateway Packet Buffer Overrun / NetDriver buffer overflow (ERR_NET_CONGESTION_EOS)
- Impacted Shards / Regions: eu-west-03 / EU
- Recommended Mitigation / 1-Click Rollback Script: eos-admin routing rollback --rule-id=EOS-NET-3010-P2 --shard=eu-west-03
@Titan-LiveOps Server cluster us-east-12 reported 450 player dropouts in the last 15 minutes. Investigate crash signatures.

[P1 INCIDENT REPORT]
- Incident Severity: P1
- Root Cause Summary: Unreal Engine Chaos Physics Replication NullReference exception (ERR_UE5_CHAOS_NULLPTR)
- Impacted Shards / Regions: us-east-12 / NA-EAST
- Recommended Mitigation / 1-Click Rollback Script: epic-config-cli set --key=p.Chaos.ReplicationSync --value=0 --broadcast=global
